hypothesis: A larger on-policy rollout batch reduces destructive sampling noise in the recurrent PPO updates.
intervention: num_envs 16 -> 64; horizon remains 32, PPO epochs and minibatches remain 4.
implied_changes: 2048 instead of 512 interactions per actor update, and 512 instead of 128 transitions per minibatch; fewer optimizer steps at equal interactions. Do not attribute an effect uniquely to scene diversity.
held_fixed: reward and gamma, finite-horizon semantics, actor/critic, optimizer hyperparameters, sensors, control, physics, sampling schedule as a function of interactions, seed 0, total 2211840 interactions.
evaluation: every 122880 interactions (60 rather than 240 updates); full screen every third interval; identical fixed cases and 8-episode diagnostics.
checkpoint: every 61440 interactions (30 rather than 120 updates). All new updates are logged.
decision: Compare full fixed-scene outcomes and prior-success retention at matched interactions. A short improvement is not acceptance; only a stable candidate advances to independent seeds and the preregistered full protocol.
holdout: Automatic pilot benchmarks use the already consumed development cohort. Fresh formal cohorts begin at 3000000 and are not used to select these candidates.
